subject: Can packrat projects using different R versions run concurrently on Shiny Server

messages.author: d52615666406e77d
messages.subject: Can packrat projects using different R versions run concurrently on Shiny Server
parts:
Is it possible to run multiple packrat projects on Shiny Server if they use different versions of R? 
If so are there certain precautions or configuration settings required?

Thanks,
James

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: Can packrat projects using different R versions run concurrently on Shiny Server
parts:
Shiny Server Pro can run multiple versions of R (http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#r_path) but not Shiny Server Open Source.

Do you have projects that won't run on the latest R?
On Wed, Feb 11, 2015 at 8:37 AM, <jab1...@gmail.com> wrote:

James

messages.subject: Re: Can packrat projects using different R versions run concurrently on Shiny Server
parts:
Hi Joe,

We currently have one fairly complex app that is using 3.0.2 and is not set up in packrat. This runs on open source Shiny Server. We want to add a new packrat project to the server, built on 3.1.1, but obviously want to avoid any conflicts. Our first app ran into problems running on 3.1.1, I believe the issue is related to dplyr changes which occurred between those versions of R. Based on your comments, testing the new app on 3.0.2 might be the best approach. BTW, we are in the process of purchasing Shiny Server Pro but until that is in place we need a work around. Thanks for the r_path info. 

James
